topic: Winter wellness for shorter days (vitamin D and daylight)
headline: Shorter days?
intro: The clocks have changed and evenings are dark early. These small habits can help you feel your best.

points.title: Get outside in daylight
points.body: Shorter days mean less sun. A midday walk helps you catch some daylight and keep moving.
points.tip: Bundle up and go at lunchtime.

points.title: Ask about vitamin D
points.body: We get less vitamin D from sunlight in winter. Ask your pharmacist if a supplement fits your needs.

points.title: Keep a sleep routine
points.body: Going to bed and waking up at the same time can help your body adjust to darker evenings.
points.tip: Dim screens an hour before bed.

points.title: Stay hydrated indoors
points.body: Dry indoor heat can leave you thirsty. Keep a water bottle nearby through the day.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.
